title: Setting off blocks every send; a send updates Last sent; no bounces
custom_preconds:
1. Sign in to the Maintenance Reminders QA build as an Owner/Admin (any user who can open Settings > Maintenance and create and edit work orders and customers).
  2. Open Settings > Maintenance. Open the schedule 'ZZAUTOTEST Highway Tractor PM', or create it with New schedule: add service 'PM-A' with a Calendar trigger of Every 6 months and canned lines, for example 'Engine oil and filter change' 0.8 hours, 'Chassis lubrication, 12 points' 0.5 hours, 'Air filter inspection' 0.3 hours and 'Brake adjustment check' 1.2 hours (4 lines, 2.8 hours). Save.
  3. Enroll units 'ZZAUTOTEST 402' and 'ZZAUTOTEST 403' of 'ZZAUTOTEST Fleet Co' so each has something due.
  4. Make sure 'ZZAUTOTEST Fleet Co' has its Send preventive maintenance notifications setting on, and a contact 'Dave Brabay' with an email address you can read (for example a QA mailbox) set as the preferred contact of unit 'ZZAUTOTEST 402'.
  5. On the QA environment, send only to a mailbox the QA team controls.
custom_steps:
1. Open Customers > Maintenance reminders (the worklist). On 402's row press Contact, then Send reminder, then Send. Read the toast and the contact card.
  2. Open the customer 'ZZAUTOTEST Fleet Co', switch Send preventive maintenance notifications off and save.
  3. On the worklist open Contact for 402 and for 403; look at Send reminder on each.
  4. Switch the setting back on.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • After sending, a toast confirms it (in the design: Reminder sent to Dave Brabay) and the contact card shows Last sent with today's date (for example Last sent 6 Oct 2026).
  • With the setting off, Send reminder is unavailable for both units, because the setting lives on the customer record, not on the unit or its enrolment.
  • The send is also recorded in the audit with the message, the recipients, the sender and the time. No screen shows the audit in this version, so the audit entry cannot be checked by hand: record this part as not checked by hand.
  • Nothing reports a bounced reminder.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-3780 (Maintenance Reminders); story SV-10575 (S19, The customer reminder email (sent by hand)); Chunk 2 MR (Confluence 897679389) as edited 5 October 2026, S19; Maintenance Reminders V1 main page (Confluence 833290250) as edited 5 October 2026, change log; read 6 Oct 2026. Source-verified 6 October 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S19-N3: “A customer whose notification setting is off cannot be sent a reminder for any of their assets, per S14-R9. The setting lives on the customer record, not on the asset and not on the enrolment”
  • S19-R14: “Every send is recorded in the audit with the message, the recipients, the user who sent it and the timestamp, per S21-R5, and updates Last sent on the contact card, per S14-R12. Today only invoice and estimate emails are recorded, on their work order, so this record is new”
  • S19-E4: “Bounces are not tracked. Nothing will report that a reminder failed to arrive”
  • Main page change log, 5 Oct 2026: “Audit recorded, no screen in v1.”
